content.what_it_is: MATLAB preprocessing script by Thomas Becker (URI / TU Braunschweig, 2023; header L1-6) that builds FUNWAVE input files (DEP.txt, MANN.txt, OBS.txt) from UTM-grid .mat data. User inputs (L10-107): folders (L14,L18), cyclic lateral BC switch (L22), DEM .mat names (L26-28), output name (L32), local grid origin/rotation x_origin_UTM=282450, y_origin_UTM=4575600, alpha_rotation=105.5 deg (L36-38), dx_cells=2 m and local extents 8800x2000 m (L42-44), four sponge thicknesses (L50-53), wavemaker depth 30.85 m and Tp 14.2 s (L58-59), flat-section wavelength factors a=1.5/b=1.0 (L62-63), transition length l_trans=100 m (L67), friction switch/file names/output/outside value 0.02 (L75-90), obstacle switch/file names/output (L97-107). Processing: loads DEM/x/y from single-field structs (L124-139), flips sign to FUNWAVE positive-down depth (L146), rotates translated UTM coordinates into the local frame with rot_mat (rotation_angle=-pi/180*alpha_rotation L151, matrix L155, translate L159-160, rotate/reshape L163-165), builds local grid (nx/ny=ceil(extent/dx) L171-172, linspace L175-176, meshgrid L179) and re-interpolates the DEM with griddata (L182); plots and saves DEM_Initial figures (L185-196). Wavemaker section (L200-238): deep-water wavelength L0=9.81*Tp^2/(2*pi) (L205), iterates linear dispersion L=L0*tanh(2*pi*d/L) to 1 mm tolerance (L208-212), flat cell counts nx_wavemaker_west/east=ceil(a|b*L/dx) (L216,L219), interpolation strip nx_interpolation=ceil(l_trans/dx) (L224), per-row linspace from depth_wavemaker to the DEM offshore edge depths (L228-238). Sponge extents (L245-249), total sizes nx_total/ny_total (L254-255), domain mesh (L258-262), zb_domain assembled: NaN init (L265), measured DEM block (L270), constant wavemaker depth west block (L274), interpolation strip (L278), eastern sponge columns copied from DEM east edge (L283-287), south/north sponges either copied edge rows (non-cyclic, L299-305) or, for cyclic BC, linearly interpolated between north and south edge rows so both outer edges match (n_vectors_cyclic=ny_s+ny_n-1 L314, interp1 per column L320-322, filled L325-331); plots DEM_Full (L336-347). Console reporting (L351-377): Mglob/Nglob, wavemaker position pos_wavemaker=(nx_sponge_west+nx_wavemaker_west)*dx_cells (L358-359), flat-section last cell, first/last real-domain cell indices, cyclic-BC reminder to zero N/S sponge in FUNWAVE input (L375-377). Writes DEP.txt with '%d ' per value, newline per row (L391-408). Friction part (L417-529, if switch_friction_file==1): same load/rotate/griddata pipeline for Manning/Chezy data (L426-460), fills domain with friction_outside then real-domain block (L477-480), plots Friction_Initial/Full (L463-492), writes MANN.txt (L506-523). Obstacle part (L533-655, if switch_obstacle_file==1): loads binary obstacle data (1=no obstacle, 0=obstacle; comment L99-100), same transform, griddata then round() to keep binary (L577-583), fills domain with ones (no obstacle outside, L605), real-domain block (L608), black/white plots (L588-619), writes OBS.txt with '%i ' (L632-649).

%Filenames of .mat input of Obstacles on UTM (Binary: 1=No

unresolved: DEP.txt/MANN.txt written with fprintf '%d ' (@L401,@L516) on floating-point values — MATLAB then prints full precision scientific notation for non-integers; whether intended over %f is unresolved (OBS.txt uses '%i ' @L642 on genuine integers)

X_local = linspace(0, dx_cells*nx_extent_local, nx_extent_local) @L175 yields spacing dx*nx/(nx-1), slightly larger than dx_cells; same for y @L176 and domain vectors @L258-259 — off-by-one vs stated cell length, intent unresolved

cyclic-BC fill @L325-331: south rows use interpolatedVectors(:, i+ny_sponge_north-1) and north rows interpolatedVectors(:,i) — mapping direction (which end equals which edge) follows from interp1([0 1],[north south]) @L321 but the index arithmetic for equality of outermost rows is not obviously symmetric; verified only that both draw from the same vector family, cross-line L314-331
griddata leaves NaN outside the convex hull of input points; zb_domain init is NaN @L265 and no NaN check before writing DEP.txt @L391-405 — FUNWAVE behavior on NaN depths not addressed in this file
friction interpolation reuses X_local/Y_local from the DEM section (@L460) assuming friction UTM grid covers the same local domain; no coverage check
hard-coded site values (origin 282450/4575600, rotation 105.5, depth 30.85, Tp 14.2) are a specific case study left as defaults — which site is not stated in the file
